claim: After the inventory closes, thinkers parked on WaitOnFlagByte(#FF, #00) resume: the first UpdateFrameRender of the close path runs the restored thinker list while $FF is still clear, so the palette loops replay their bundle and the HDMA / PPU-register thinkers re-initialise.

trial.control: in scene $01 with $16 set and $1C clear, let flag_gated_palette_warm apply bundle #02; log CGRAM writes (palette buffer $7F0A00) and the COP stream of the thinker for 120 frames
trial.forced: open the inventory (Select) and close it; repeat in scene $2F (gold_ship_wreck_palette) and in scene $E8 (sE8_comet_display_config rewrites TM/TS/BG1SC)
observe: PaletteStart executes for the thinker in the first frame after the close ({192186})
the thinker sets $0A1F bit 7 again before the overlay sets it at {192190}
no replay while the inventory is open

confirms: the wake at inventory close described in sys_scene_setup_done (set and clear effects)
refutes: no PaletteStart / register rewrite in the close frame (the thinkers would stay parked)

claim: Only two code sites clear $FF: the direct write at scene_lifecycle.asm:844 {253423} and at inventory_overlay.asm:133 {191819}.

trial.control: write breakpoint on $0A1F with a condition on bit 7 going 1 -> 0, play title -> South Cape -> inventory -> another scene -> Dark Space for several minutes
observe: PC of every write that clears bit 7
count per scene change and per inventory open

confirms: the absence claim in sys_scene_setup_done (no other clearer)
refutes: a third PC that clears bit 7

claim: The South Cape church lesson flag and the boot-logo latch are the same bit and never meet: after a boot (or reset) $10 is clear when the title is reached, and Load Game replaces the array.

trial.control: cold boot; watch $0A02 bit 0 through the first logo, the second logo, the title and New Game; then play the South Cape church lesson
trial.forced: load a save written after the lesson ($10 set), then reach the title again by reset and choose New Game
observe: whether the lesson plays on New Game after a loaded game and a reset
whether any path reaches the title without a boot (scene $FC queue sites)

confirms: both scoped meanings of $10 and the "cannot meet" claim
refutes: the flag set on arrival at New Game (lesson skipped) or the first logo skipped
